name: GPU skinning in the lit and shadow pipelines
body: A skinned mesh carries up to four joint indices and weights per vertex in a second vertex buffer, so the 48-byte `Vertex` and every existing pipeline stay as they are. The lit and shadow vertex shaders get skinned variants that blend a palette of joint matrices pushed as a vertex uniform (32 joints). `DrawItem` gains an optional palette. Needs a GPU test (a bending tube) and recompiled SPIR-V and MSL.
